architecture.description: classical branch Linear(feature_dim -> hidden) -> ReLU; quantum branch Linear(feature_dim -> 2**qubits) adapter -> qmlpipe.models.build_qnn with reduced qubits, amplitude embedding and trainable StronglyEntanglingLayers emitting 2 logits; final Linear(concat([classical_hidden, quantum_logits]) -> 2).
architecture.fusion: nn.Linear(hidden + 2, 2) on the concatenation of both branch outputs
architecture.hybrid_evidence: classical, quantum adapter, quantum circuit weights and the fusion layer all contain trainable parameters and receive gradients; the classical branch is absent from a pure QNN, so both paths are required at inference.
architecture.quantum_backend: PennyLane default.qubit, interface='torch', diff_method='backprop', analytic (shots=None); CPU simulation only
architecture.quantum_branch: nn.Linear(D, 2**qubits) -> build_qnn(qubits, layers, amplitude embedding, strongly_entangling ansatz) -> 2 logits
architecture.type: parallel-concatenation hybrid (classical compression + variational quantum head)

claim_boundary: HYBRID-D01 diagnostic arm on the frozen fresh 70:20:10 grouped splits. classical branch Linear(feature_dim -> hidden) -> ReLU; quantum branch Linear(feature_dim -> 2**qubits) adapter -> qmlpipe.models.build_qnn with reduced qubits, amplitude embedding and trainable StronglyEntanglingLayers emitting 2 logits; final Linear(concat([classical_hidden, quantum_logits]) -> 2). Both branches are trainable and both contribute to the fused classifier; this is a hybrid model, not a pure QNN and not a parameter-free quantum kernel. All quantum execution is CPU simulation (default.qubit, analytic); no quantum advantage is asserted and no speed or hardware claim is made. Paired comparisons are reported with Holm correction and decisions are computed from the data; they are evidence for or against a difference, not a licence to claim an advantage without the full matched-control and Critic gate. TEST is sealed and scored once; failures are recorded as warnings and never fabricated.
